messages:
alice_support: Hey team — customer `BrightLayer` on eu-west dedicated pool reporting sudden p95 token latency jump + intermittent 429s since ~09:10 UTC. Also seeing a weird auth 401 spike in logs and an invoice delta that doesn't add up. Putting initial logs below, can infra take a look?

ben_infra: On it. Can you drop the tenant id and pool id? any recent config changes?

alice_support: tenant=brightlayer-prod, pool=eu-west-dedicated-3. No config changes from customer side. They said nothing changed in their traffic pattern other than a small model-size bump yesterday. Logs: `2026-03-16T09:11:03Z ERROR token-service 429 route=/v1/generate tenant=brightlayer-prod` and repeating. Also seeing `auth: 401 invalid signature` interleaved.

dan_oncall: I pulled GPU metrics for eu-west-dedicated-3 from 08:00-09:30. Observed recurring bursts of SM utilization on node eu3-n12 with 2x SM spikes that line up with the 429 window. NVSM throughput also jumps. Possible MIG sibling interference.

carla_cs: Customer says their tail latency for interactive chat went from 120ms p95 to ~1.2s and some requests get throttled. They started a test job that sends 1 request/sec from 50 connections.

ben_infra: Can we get a MIG map for eu3-n12? I want to confirm partitioning and whether BrightLayer is sharing with any noisy tenants.

perf-bot: MIG map for eu3-n12 as of 09:05 UTC: `gpu0:1g.10gb root, gpu1:1g.20gb root, gpu2:2g.10gb (tenant=brightlayer-prod), gpu3:2g.10gb (tenant=thirdparty-ads)`

ben_infra: Interesting — brightlayer is on a 2g slice co-located with thirdparty-ads. Thirdparty-ads has a known bursty image-generation batch job. That could explain SM bursts.

alice_support: But what about the auth 401s and billing delta? Are they related or separate?

dan_oncall: 401s look like short-lived token validation failures in the auth proxy — many 401s correspond to the same seconds as the 429s. Hypothesis: when the node is overloaded, the auth proxy (co-located sidecar) times out and returns 401/429 cascades. Billing delta may be due to repeated retries increasing token counts.

elaine_eng_runtime: Flagging eng-runtime. We need to know if KV cache or L3 cache thrashing is causing performance collapse under MIG co-residency. Can you capture a short nsys profile and dmesg around one of the bursts?

ben_infra: Pasted a short capture from 09:12 burst: `nvidia-smi dmon -s u -d 1` snippet: 
SM% GPU%   FB%   ECC
95   98    72    0  
...and `dmesg` shows `nvhost: gpu0: pci_bus 0000:3b:00: device error: DMA write timeout` repeated 3x.

carla_cs: Customer volunteered to pause thirdparty-ads for 10 mins to test isolation, would you like them to proceed?

ben_infra: Yes please. If pausing removes spikes, we have strong evidence of noisy neighbor MIG interference.

alice_support: Customer paused their adjacent tenant at 09:18. Spikes dropped immediately. p95 returned to ~140ms. 429s stopped.

elaine_eng_runtime: Thanks — confirms interference. Two action items: 1) Move BrightLayer to an isolated slice (temp migration) and offer credits for impact. 2) Improve scheduler packing logic to avoid pairing heavy-burst tenants on 2g slices for now. I'll open an internal ticket with profiling artifacts.

dan_oncall: For immediate mitigation I've bumped autoscale floor for brightlayer to +1 slice to reduce tail risk and scheduled a controlled repro window tomorrow 09:00-10:00 UTC with eng-runtime.

perf-bot: Created ticket RN-1427: "MIG cache thrash in eu-west-dedicated-3 — noisy neighbor repro" with artifacts (nsys, dmon, dmesg) attached and linked to customer case CS-9812.

carla_cs: I notified the customer and offered one week service credit and the migration window. They're OK with migration and want post-mortem.

ben_infra: Quick notes for postmortem: suspected root cause = L3/KV cache contention across MIG slices on same physical GPU leading to auth proxy timeouts and retry storms. Evidence = SM% alignment, dmesg DMA timeouts, immediate remediation when neighbor paused. Recommended mitigations: anti-affinity policy in packer for 2g/2g combos, autoscale safety bump, and temporary isolation for impacted tenants.

elaine_eng_runtime: I'll add a long-term work item to modify kernel selection to favor lower-SM-affinity for co-located 2g slices and experiment with KV cache partitioning.

alice_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

dan_oncall: Moving to resolved for now, will update RN-1427 after repro.

perf-bot: Note: follow-up reminder set for 2026-03-17 09:00 UTC to review repro results."
